title: Dallas Mavericks hire Michigan NCAA champion Dusty May as new head coach
content: The Dallas Mavericks officially hired Dusty May on June 23, 2026, making the jump to the NBA after leading Michigan to the 2026 NCAA National Championship.

title: Bucks agree to blockbuster trade sending Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis to Miami Heat
content: Milwaukee Bucks agreed on June 23, 2026 to trade two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis to the Miami Heat in exchange for Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel'el Ware, and major draft capital, instantly making Miami a premier East contender ahead of free agency.

title: Hornets agree to blockbuster trade sending LaMelo Ball to Minnesota Timberwolves
content: Charlotte Hornets and Minnesota Timberwolves agreed in principle on June 25, 2026 to a multi-team framework centering on LaMelo Ball moving to Minnesota alongside Josh Green, while Charlotte receives Naz Reid and multiple future first-round picks.

title: NBA Insiders Brian Windhorst and Marc Stein project Lakers stay as likeliest outcome for LeBron James, flag Warriors threat
content: Ahead of 2026 free agency, ESPN insider Brian Windhorst reported that re-signing with the Lakers remains the most logical frontrunner given LeBron James' family roots and max flexibility, while warning Golden State is a threat due to Steph Curry, Steve Kerr, and Draymond Green ties. Marc Stein similarly called James entrenched in Southern California even as the Warriors monitor MLE pathways.

title: Shams Charania: Cavaliers guard James Harden declines $42.3 million player option to negotiate new deal
content: ESPN's Shams Charania reported on June 29, 2026 that Cleveland Cavaliers veteran guard James Harden declined his $42.3 million player option for 2026-27 to pursue a restructured multi-year contract in Cleveland, reshaping the Cavaliers' offseason cap outlook.

title: Top 15 remaining 2026 NBA free agents: Jalen Duren, LeBron James, James Harden still available - NBC Sports
content: Entering 2026 free agency, LeBron James headlines available stars alongside Jalen Duren and James Harden and has not yet announced whether he will re-sign with the Lakers or leave Los Angeles.

title: Draymond Green’s decision is Step 1 in Warriors’ plan to acquire LeBron James and Anthony Davis - Yahoo Sports
content: Draymond Green opted out of his player option as the opening move in Golden State's cap-flexibility blueprint to pursue LeBron James alongside Stephen Curry in 2026 NBA free agency.

title: Warriors' Updated NBA Salary Cap as Draymond Declines Contract Option Amid LeBron, AD Rumors - Bleacher Report
content: By declining his $27.7 million player option, Draymond Green gave the Golden State Warriors maneuvering room below the luxury-tax aprons while signaling willingness to take a team-friendly deal to recruit marquee free-agent help.

title: Reports: LeBron James will play for team other than Lakers in 2026-27 - NBA.com
content: LeBron James has informed the Los Angeles Lakers he plans to play for another franchise in the 2026-27 NBA season as free agency opens.

title: Kristaps Porziņģis opts to remain with Warriors on 2-year contract - NBA.com
content: Center Kristaps Porzingis exercised his option to remain with the Golden State Warriors on a two-year commitment, stabilizing Golden State's frontcourt rotation ahead of the free-agency moratorium.

title: Timberwolves among teams to contact LeBron James in free agency: Sources - The Athletic
content: Fresh off agreeing to acquire LaMelo Ball to pair with Anthony Edwards, the Minnesota Timberwolves are among the suitors contacting LeBron James in free agency.

title: The Sixers’ 2026-27 salary-cap outlook heading into free agency - Liberty Ballers
content: Heading into the 2026 NBA free-agency moratorium, Philadelphia 76ers president Daryl Morey holds multiple roster-building exceptions, draft capital, and non-guaranteed contracts that can be reshaped around Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey.

title: Timberwolves' quiet roster move might be a hint at their free agency plan - Dunking with Wolves
content: Ahead of the free-agency opening bell, Minnesota's front office made a minor roster housekeeping move as the Timberwolves balance luxury-tax constraints with ambitious offseason targets.

title: What Free Agency Tools the Sixers Are Working With Heading Into Moratorium Period - Sports Illustrated
content: Liberty Ballers breaks down the exact exceptions, bird rights, and apron restrictions shaping the Philadelphia 76ers' roster construction entering July 1 free agency.

title: Warriors Have Emergency Solution If Needed for LeBron James Plan - Sports Illustrated
content: Sports Illustrated reports the Golden State Warriors have prepared a contingency sign-and-trade structure if Draymond Green's pay-cut restructuring alone is insufficient to accommodate a LeBron James pursuit.

title: Lakers agree to four-year $60M deal with Quentin Grimes in post-LeBron roster pivot around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves
content: With LeBron James departing Los Angeles, the Lakers pivoted toward building around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves ($185M max extension talks) by agreeing to a four-year, $60 million free-agent deal with Quentin Grimes on July 1, 2026.

title: Lakers agree to sign-and-trade deal for Utah Jazz center Walker Kessler
content: Reported on July 1, 2026 (official July 8), the Los Angeles Lakers agreed to acquire restricted free agent center Walker Kessler from the Utah Jazz in a sign-and-trade sending two unprotected first-round picks and two first-round pick swaps to Utah as Los Angeles reshapes its roster around Luka Doncic.

title: Celtics' & 76ers' Updated Depth Chart, Salary Cap, Draft Picks After Jaylen Brown-Paul George Trade - Bleacher Report
content: Following Philadelphia's blockbuster agreement to trade Paul George and draft picks for Jaylen Brown, the 76ers' updated depth chart pairs Brown with Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey while forcing tight apron management.

title: Miami Heat and Cleveland Cavaliers linked as primary LeBron James free agency suitors after Lakers exit
content: Following LeBron James' exit notice to Los Angeles, reporters linked both the Miami Heat—energized by their Giannis Antetokounmpo trade agreement—and the Cleveland Cavaliers—balancing a hometown reunion pitch while negotiating James Harden's new deal—as aggressive contenders alongside Golden State.

title: 76ers' salary cap problem clear after Jaylen Brown trade, Anfernee Simons signing - Yahoo Sports
content: After acquiring Jaylen Brown and adding guard Anfernee Simons, Philadelphia faces a delicate salary-cap squeeze that will require creative minimum-contract or exception pitches to fill out its veteran wing rotation.

title: Jaylen Brown set to form All-Star trio with Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey in Philadelphia - AP News
content: With Jaylen Brown joining Joel Embiid and Klutch Sports client Tyrese Maxey, Philadelphia immediately jumps to the top tier of Eastern Conference title contenders entering the 2026-27 season.

title: Game Over Podcast: Rich Paul breaks out whiteboard for LeBron James' 10 realistic destinations after Jaylen Brown traded to Philly
content: On the July 3, 2026 episode of Game Over with Max Kellerman and Rich Paul, LeBron James' Klutch Sports agent mapped out 10 free-agency destinations on a whiteboard—explicitly highlighting the Philadelphia 76ers after their Jaylen Brown trade alongside the Cavaliers, Heat, Nuggets, and Timberwolves.

title: Timberwolves ‘ramping up’ strong LeBron James free agency push - Yahoo Sports
content: Yahoo Sports reports the Minnesota Timberwolves are ramping up an aggressive free-agency pitch to LeBron James, hoping to pair him with Anthony Edwards and incoming point guard LaMelo Ball.

title: The Jaylen Brown trade was a risk that the Sixers had to take - Liberty Ballers
content: Philadelphia traded Paul George and draft capital to acquire Jaylen Brown to pair with Joel Embiid and Klutch Sports client Tyrese Maxey, transforming the 76ers into an Eastern Conference powerhouse.

title: Rockets trade Dorian Finney-Smith and three second-round picks to Hornets for cash
content: On July 3, 2026, the Houston Rockets traded veteran forward Dorian Finney-Smith along with Memphis' 2027 second-round pick and Houston's 2028 and 2033 second-rounders to the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for cash considerations.

title: LeBron James free agency: Which teams could make blockbuster moves to entice the all-time great? - CBS Sports
content: Analysts examine which contenders—including the Philadelphia 76ers, Golden State Warriors, Cleveland Cavaliers, Miami Heat, and Minnesota Timberwolves—have the financial pathways to land LeBron James.

title: Grading the Biggest NBA Offseason Trades and 2026 Free Agency Signings - Bleacher Report
content: Roundtable grades for the early wave of 2026 NBA offseason trades across Orlando, Atlanta, Houston, and Charlotte as teams lock in mid-level signings.

title: Timberwolves Announce 2026 NBA Summer League Roster and Schedule - NBA.com
content: The Minnesota Timberwolves announced their 2026 Las Vegas NBA Summer League roster and game schedule featuring rookie draft picks and two-way prospects.

title: 76ERS ACQUIRE 5X ALL-STAR AND 2X ALL-NBA SELECTION JAYLEN BROWN - NBA.com
content: The Philadelphia 76ers officially announced the acquisition of five-time All-Star and Finals MVP Jaylen Brown, formalizing the centerpiece move of Daryl Morey's 2026 offseason overhaul.

title: Miami Heat officially complete Giannis Antetokounmpo trade as NBA moratorium lifts
content: As the 2026 NBA offseason moratorium lifted on July 6, the Miami Heat formally finalized their blockbuster trade acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the Milwaukee Bucks.

title: Golden State Warriors NBA free agency tracker 2026: Live signings, updates, trades, and more - Yahoo Sports
content: Tracking every Golden State Warriors signing, contract option, and salary-cap update during the opening week of 2026 NBA free agency as Draymond Green remains unsigned pending star-chasing clarity.

title: Warriors not among teams in LeBron James' free-agency hierarchy, per Shams - NBC Sports Bay Area & California
content: Despite Draymond Green's contract opt-out and Golden State's public interest, ESPN's Shams Charania reports the Warriors are currently not positioned inside the top tier of LeBron James' free-agency hierarchy.

title: NBA Summer League: Ultimate Timberwolves Guide - Canis Hoopus
content: Canis Hoopus previews Minnesota's Summer League coaching staff, sophomore rotation battles, and key G-League prospects heading into Las Vegas competition.

title: Pelicans 1st Half Highlights vs. Timberwolves | 2026 Summer League - NBA.com
content: Highlights from the first half of the New Orleans Pelicans vs. Minnesota Timberwolves 2026 NBA Summer League matchup in Las Vegas.

title: Kawhi Leonard trade to Raptors put on hold until Clippers’ Aspiration investigation ends - The Athletic - The New York Times
content: The Toronto Raptors and Los Angeles Clippers placed a blockbuster Kawhi Leonard trade on hold until the NBA completes its investigation into the Clippers' Aspiration endorsement and salary-cap circumvention allegations.

title: LeBron James Free Agency Roundtable: Expert Predictions for Superstar's Next Team - Sports Illustrated
content: NBA beat writers debate whether LeBron James will prioritize a hometown return to Cleveland, a championship wing slot alongside Embiid, Brown, and Maxey in Philadelphia, or a surprise Western Conference suitor.

title: LeBron James' free agency market: What six teams can offer him - ESPN
content: ESPN outlines what six suitors including the 76ers, Warriors, Cavaliers, Heat, Nuggets, and Timberwolves can offer LeBron James financially and competitively.

title: Timberwolves finalize four-team LaMelo Ball trade with Hornets, Nets and Bulls as moratorium lifts
content: The Minnesota Timberwolves officially completed their four-team trade acquiring LaMelo Ball on July 11, 2026, routing Julius Randle to Brooklyn and Nic Claxton to Chicago while sending Naz Reid and picks to Charlotte.

title: LeBron James’ list of potential NBA free agency destinations narrows to three - Yahoo Sports
content: Nearly two weeks into free agency, league sources indicate LeBron James' list of serious 2026 destinations has narrowed to three finalists led by the Philadelphia 76ers and Cleveland Cavaliers.

title: Sources: 76ers' pursuit of LeBron led by Maxey, Embiid, Brown - ESPN
content: ESPN reports Philadelphia's aggressive recruitment of LeBron James is being spearheaded directly by Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, and newly acquired All-Star Jaylen Brown, pitching an immediate Eastern Conference superteam.

title: 5 Remaining Free-Agent Guards and Wings the Warriors Should Target - Sports Illustrated
content: With marquee star pursuits stalling, Sports Illustrated identifies five remaining free-agent guards and wings Golden State should consider using its mid-level exception to sign.

title: LeBron James free agency: What is Plan B for teams that miss out on signing NBA's all-time scoring leader? - CBS Sports
content: Front offices across the league prepare fallback roster moves in case LeBron James spurns their offers, with Golden State, Miami, and Minnesota evaluating secondary veteran depth.

title: Timberwolves summer league: Biggest winners and losers - Bring Me the Sports
content: Bring Me The News recaps the biggest winners and losers from the Minnesota Timberwolves' 2026 Las Vegas Summer League finale, highlighting defensive standout rookies.

title: Thunder trade Luguentz Dort to Atlanta Hawks in three-team deal for second-round picks
content: On July 19, 2026, the Oklahoma City Thunder traded defensive wing Luguentz Dort to the Atlanta Hawks as part of a three-team transaction netting Oklahoma City three future second-round draft picks.

title: Dub Hub: LeBron James’ free agency decision remains without a timetable, per report - Golden State Of Mind
content: With late July approaching, Shams Charania reports LeBron James' final free-agency decision remains without a formal public timetable as finalists await word.

title: LeBron James picks Philadelphia as final NBA challenge - NBA.com
content: LeBron James shocked NBA insiders by declining Cleveland, Miami, and Golden State to agree to a two-year, roughly $8 million veteran-minimum contract (~$3.9M in 2026-27 with a second-year player option) with the Philadelphia 76ers alongside Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, and Klutch Sports client Tyrese Maxey after Rich Paul confirmed the 1 a.m. Friday decision.

title: LeBron James picks Philadelphia as final NBA challenge - Wire Reprint
content: LeBron James shocked NBA insiders by declining Cleveland, Miami, and Golden State to agree to a two-year, roughly $8 million veteran-minimum contract (~$3.9M in 2026-27 with a second-year player option) with the Philadelphia 76ers alongside Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, and Klutch Sports client Tyrese Maxey after Rich Paul confirmed the 1 a.m. Friday decision Wire.

title: Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey recruited LeBron James - Yahoo Sports
content: Following LeBron James' official decision to join Philadelphia, Yahoo Sports details how Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, and Klutch Sports teammate Tyrese Maxey worked in lockstep to seal the 76ers' recruiting pitch.

title: Warriors’ focus shifts to Draymond Green, young core after LeBron James joins 76ers - The New York Times
content: After LeBron James officially chose the Philadelphia 76ers, the Golden State Warriors pivoted their offseason focus squarely back to finalizing a new contract with Draymond Green and developing their young core.

title: Warriors’ pursuit of LeBron James offers hard dose of reality for frustrated fans - The New York Times
content: Golden State's failed pursuit of LeBron James leaves the Warriors facing tight cap realities and forces the front office to re-sign Draymond Green on a short-term pact.

title: How LeBron James' 4th free agency move led him to Philadelphia - NBA.com
content: NBA.com chronicles the timeline behind LeBron James' fourth career free-agency decision, tracing how Philadelphia's Jaylen Brown blockbuster and Maxey-Embiid recruiting pitch won out over Cleveland and Golden State.

title: The Draymond Green Show: Draymond explains why LeBron James picked 76ers over Warriors despite Puerto Rico recruitment
content: On the July 28, 2026 episode of The Draymond Green Show, Draymond Green revealed that Golden State pursued LeBron James aggressively—including recruiting him on a Puerto Rico golf trip—but historical Finals baggage with Stephen Curry pushed LeBron toward Philadelphia.

title: 76ers trade Johni Broome and 2027 second-round pick to Clippers to clear apron room for KCP
content: On July 28, 2026, days after landing LeBron James, the Philadelphia 76ers traded forward Johni Broome and a 2027 second-round pick to the LA Clippers for cash considerations to create first-apron flexibility for a minimum-salary signing of veteran guard Kentavious Caldwell-Pope.
